invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Room.room_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Reservation.reservation_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Reservation.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
Reservation.room_id must reference an existing Room.room_id
A reservation must not overlap with an existing reservation in the same room.
If a reservation starts at or after the end time of an existing reservation in the same room, it does not overlap.
If a reservation ends at or before the start time of an existing reservation in the same room, it does not overlap.
A room cannot have two reservations that occupy the same time interval.
A reservation with a start time that is greater than or equal to its end time is invalid and must be rejected.
A reservation must be associated with a valid customer through the customer_id field.
A reservation must be associated with a valid room through the room_id field.
A customer can have multiple reservations across different rooms and time periods.
A room's capacity must not be exceeded by the number of guests in a reservation.
Reservations that overlap in time and room are rejected during creation or update.
